newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept household spending down 4.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept household spending down 4.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's household spending in September fell 4.4 percent in real terms from a year earlier to an average 299,096 yen per household, the government's Management and Coordination Agency said on Thursday.
The agency said household spending in the July-September quarter fell 3.0 percent in real terms from the same period last year to an average 317,659 yen per month per household.
